The issuer shows solid financial flexibility with a strong current ratio (current assets/current liabilities ≈ 2.35) and moderate leverage (total liabilities of 1,971M vs. shareholders’ equity of 1,863M). Profitability is healthy with net income of 400M on revenue of 3,617M (~11%) and EBIT of 474M, indicating good operating performance and earnings generation, but the absence of detailed debt/coverage metrics prevents a higher rating.

DECISION: BBB+
